[10] (ran2_cr_chunks 38.304, sim=0.5713)
[CR CR0233r2 for 38.304] Reason for change: This CR introduces the enhancements for idle and inactive mode procedures specified as part of the Work Item on Non-Terrestrial network in NR. Summary of change: Add definitions for Non-terrestrial network and Quasi earth fixed cell in section 3.1. Add abbreviation for High Altitude Platform Station and Non-Terrestrial Network in 3.2. Add support for ephemeris/location/distance based cell selection and reselection and editor’s notes for the FFS part in section 5.2.1. Add time and location triggered measurements in 5.2.4.2. Add “Editor’s note: Working assumption: A new bit, e.g. cellBarred-NTN, is introduced in SIB1 for NR-NTN. FFS on the expected UE behaviour upon reception of the new bit and the existing cellBarred.” In 5.3.1. Add trackingAreaLi
